spans.s: एकक॑ (f. एकका & एकिका) sole, single.
एककालम् adv. (only) once a day.
एकका˚लिकम् adv. (only) once a day.
एकक्रम (˚— & instr.) mutually or at once.*

एकक्रियाविधि m. application of one and the same
verb.
ए॑कचक्र a. having (only) one wheel.
एकचर॑ a. going alone, solitary.
1 एकचित्त n. one and the same thought.

2 एकचित्त a. having one and the same thought, agreeing;
abstr. ˚ता f.
एकच्छत्र n. = एकातपत्र.
एकज॑ a. born or growing alone.
एकजात a. born of the same parents.

एकजाति a. having (only) one birth (cf. द्विजाति) or
belonging to the same family.
एकत॑ m. N. of a cert. mythol. being.
एक॑ता f. unity, identity.
ए॑कतम a. one of many.
एकतम॑ a. one of many.
ए॑कतय f. ई single.
एकतर a. one of two.
एकतस् adv. from or on one side, also = abj. of एक.
एकतोदन्त् a. having only one row of teeth.

एकत्र adv. in one or in the same place, together, also =
loc. of एक.
एकत्रिंश॑ a. the thirty-first.
ए॑कत्रिंशत् f. thirty-one.
एकत्व n. = एकता, also = singular (g.).

एकदा adv. at once, at the same time, sometimes, at a
certain time = once upon a time.
एकदुःख a. having the same sorrow.
1 एकधन m. a kind of jug ((r.)).
2 एकधन॑ n. one (part of the) property.

3 एकधन a. having something as one's only property or
wealth, quite filled with (—˚).
एकधर्म a. having the same nature.
एक˚धर्मिन् a. having the same nature.

एकधा॑ adv. simply, singly;
 together with (instr.).
ए॑कपञ्चाशत् f. fifty-one.
एकपत्नि a. having (only) one wife.

ए॑कपद् a. having (only) one foot, limping, lame,
incomplete^1, f. एकपदी foot-path.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

एक˚पा॑द्, a. having (only) one foot,
limping, lame, incomplete

ए॑क˚पदी f. एकपदी foot-path.
f. foot-path.
1 एकपाद m. one foot.

2 ए॑कपाद a. one-footed;
 f. आ N. of a Rākṣasī.
एकपर॑ a. only and solely important or dear.
एकपलाधिक n. one pala more.
एकपातिन् a. being alone, solitary.
एकपार्थिव m. single ruler, monarch.
एकपीत a. only i.e. quite yellow.
एकपुरुष m. only one man or the one (supreme) spirit.
एकफल a. offering the same fruit as (—˚).
एकबुद्धि a. having only one thought, unanimous.
एकभक्त a. devoted only to one, faithful.
एक˚भक्ति a. devoted only to one, faithful.
1 एकभाव m. the being one, oneness, simplicity.
2 एकभाव a. being or becoming one.
एकभाविन् a. the same.
एक˚भूत a. the same.
1 एकमति f. the mind fixed upon one object.
2 एकमति a. unanimous.

एकमनस् a. the same + having the mind fixed upon one
thing, thoughtful.
एकमय f. ई only consisting of or in (—˚).
एकमाषक n. one masa (a cert. weight).
एकमूल a. having but one root.
*एकयष्टि f. a single string of pearls.
एकयष्टि˚का f. a single string of pearls.
एकयोनि a. of the same womb or origin.
1 एकरस m. the only inclination or pleasure.
एकरात्रिक a. sufficient for one night or day.
एकरिक्थिन् m. coheir.
1 एकरूप n. one form or manner.

2 ए॑करूप a. of one colour, uniform;
 n. N. of two metres.
एकरूपता f. uniformity, immutability.

एकर्च॑ a. consisting of one verse;
 n. such a hymn.
एकर्षि॑ m. the only or chief Ṛṣi.
एकल a. one, alone.

एकलोचन a. one-eyed;
 f. आ N. of a Rākṣasī.
एकवचन॑ n. the singular number.
एकवर्ण a. one-coloured, not brindled.
एकवसन a. having only one garment.
एकवस्त्र (abstr. ˚ता f.) & ˚वासस् a. the same.

एकविंश॑ f. ई the twenty-first or consisting of
twenty-one.
एकविंशक f. ˚शिका the same.

एकविंशत् f. pl., ए॑कविंशति f. sgl. (& pl.)
twenty-one.

ए॑कविध a. of one kind, simple;
 identical.
एकवीर॑ m. an only, i.e. an incomparable hero.
2 एकवेणी f. consisting of a single braid (hair).
1 एकवेद m. only one Veda.
2 एकवेद a. knowing only one Veda.
एकवेश्म॑न् n. one house or stable.

ए॑कव्रत a. commanding alone or devoted only to one,
i.e. faithful.
1 ए॑कशत n. 101.
2 एकशत a. the 101^st.
एकशततम॑ a. the 101^st.
एकशस् adv. singly.

एकश्रुति a. monotonous;
 f. monotony, a kind of accent (g.).
एकषष्ट॑ a. the sixty-first.
एकषष्टि f. sixty-one.

एकसंश्रय a. keeping together;
 m. as subst.
एकसप्तत a. the seventy-first.
ए॑कसप्तति f. seventy-one.
एकसप्ततिगुण a. multiplied by seventy-one.

एकसहस्र n. 1001;
 adj. the 1001st.
एकसार a. whose only essence is (—˚).
एकस्तम्भ a. resting upon one pillar.

एकस्थ॑ a. standing together, joined, concentrated,
assembled. — With भू join, meet.*
एकस्थान n. one or the same place.

एकांश m. part;
 ˚ता f. partnership.
एकाकि॑न् a. alone, solitary.
1 एकाक्ष a. having only one axle.
2 एकाक्ष a. one-eyed.

1 एकाक्षर॑ n. the only imperishable;
 only one syllable.

2 ए॑काक्षर a. monosyllable;
 n. a monosyllabic word.

एकाग्र a. having one point or aim, fixed, concentrated,
intent or attentive upon (—˚). n. & ˚तस् adv., abstr. ˚ता f.,
˚त्व n.

एकाङ्ग n. a single member or part;
 m. pl. a body guard.
एकाङ्गरूपक n. an iYcomplete simile.
1 एकात्मन् m. the one spirit.
एकादश॑ f. ई the eleventh.
एकादशगुण a. eleven times as much.
ए॑कादशन् a. eleven.
एकादशम a. the eleventh.
एकादशद्वार a. having eleven gates.
एकाधिक a. more by one.
एकानर्थ a. suffering the same mischief.

एकानुदिष्ट n. (sc. शाद्ध) funeral meal in honour of
one ancestor.

1 एकान्त m. a solitary place, loneliness^1, exclusiveness,
absolute oneness. एकान्त (˚—), एकान्तम्, एका˚न्तेन, एका˚न्तात्, &
एका˚न्ततस् adv. exclusively, absolutely, wholly, necessarily.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

2 एकान्त a. quite devoted to or intent upon (loc. or —˚);
abstr. ˚ता f.
एकान्तभीरु a. quite afraid or timorous.

एकान्त^1र a. separated by one intermediate member.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
एकान्तशील a. fond of solitude.
एकान्तसाध्य a. quite practicable.
एकान्तहित a. quite good, perfect.
एकान्तिन् a. = 2 एकान्त, abstr. ˚न्तित्व n.
एकान्नादिन् a. eating the food given by one.

एकान्वय a. belonging to the same family, related to
(gen.).
एकापाय m. diminution by one (in each).
2 एकायन a. passable for only one, narrow.
एकार m. the sound ए.
1 एकार्थ m. one and the same matter.
एकावलि f. a single string of pearls (adj. —˚ f. ई).
एकाव˚ली f. a single string of pearls (adj. —˚ f. ई).
एकाह॑ m. period or ceremony of one day.
एकाहन् n. one single day.
